text_block_list.text:
On the way home. I ran into that white cat 
again, but— for some reason, it didn't 
come near me today.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...She's gone. Well, I guess that makes 
sense...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, the other day I tried to 
rescue Shiro... and I failed."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—I told you that Shiro's been getting 
weaker, right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
That's why I decided it's time for Shiro 
to be an indoor cat. I even found someone 
willing to adopt her.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Shiro. It's alright now...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You don't have to live outside anymore. 
Here, come over this way...

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Hiss!!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...I've never seen Shiro so angry before. 
Ugh~ My head is totally spinning.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
――Still, eventually I started to wonder. 
"Why was Shiro a stray in the first 
place?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Because she's such a smart, friendly cat. 
And yet, never settling down in any home, 
she chose to keep living outside all 
along."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now I think... it's because surviving in 
the wild was Shiro's pride.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I just unilaterally forced my idea 
onto them... thinking that living at home 
was what makes someone happy..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—And yet, that kind of thing is what I 
personally can't stand the most~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Still. I'll try talking to Shiro one 
more time. Because it's true that I just 
want her to live in peace.

"Still, what to do is up to you, Shiro..." 
Seiun Sky muttered quietly.

And on the day of... Seiun Sky was waiting 
for Shiro along his patrol route.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, Shiro. Sorry about the other day. 
For acting on my own..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
In that harsh stray world... Shiro stayed 
true to his own way of living all along, 
didn't he?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Still, though. I think you've worked 
hard enough.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't help but think it. I just want 
Shiro to live a happy, peaceful life now. 
Because we're friends..."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, these are just my feelings. What 
to do next... I'll leave that up to you, 
Shiro.

text_block_list.name: White Cat
text_block_list.text: ...Meow.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Shiro...!

Shiro slowly walked up to Seiun Sky and 
gently nestled into her arms.

And so... she headed off toward her new 
home together with Seiun Sky.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad she made it through safely, 
but... It's going to be lonely without 
her. Ugh, Beatrix...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
King, you still haven't given up on that 
name...? Besides, he's a male cat.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
But are you all right, Sei-chan? Saying 
goodbye to a friend looks really painful, 
yes...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it'd be a lie if I said I wasn't 
lonely~. Nyahaha.
choice_data_list:
It's not like we'll never see each other 
again.
Glad Shiro was willing to listen.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well, it'd be a lie if I said I wasn't 
lonely~. Nyahaha.
choice_data_list:
It's not like we'll never see each other 
again.
Glad Shiro was willing to listen.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, you're right. Sei-chan plans on 
going to check on Shiro now and then too."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, so your name won't be Shiro 
anymore. Literally starting your second 
cat-life, huh...?"

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Food just shows up without having to say a 
word, so warm and cozy... Must be nice. 
Retirement life, that is.
choice_data_list: You're not ready for that yet!?
It's still way too early for you, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
I know, I know. Sei-chan's still gonna 
give it her all. ...Following Shiro's 
example, of course!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm so glad. I was really worried that 
I was just being selfish, you see."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Still, Sei-chan's thoughtfulness wasn't in 
vain. And they all lived happily ever 
after.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Well, Shiro retired without a hitch, 
but Sei-chan is still full of energy."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Overcoming the farewell to a friend, 
Sei-chan makes her grand comeback... and 
all that!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"...Oho. My, oh my, what a big kitty cat 
we have here~."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, without further ado... Time 
to get my floof on!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Take this! And this! How's that, do you 
give up?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
There, there. You don't have to push 
yourself to take Shiro's place, Sei-chan 
is just fine.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Having you just be you is the absolute 
best, Trainer! ...Nyahaha♪
